declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 6 of 12 cases qualify: four involve IPC 307 (attempt to murder), two of those also carry 435/436 (mischief by fire, max 7yr-life) or 452 (house-trespass after preparation for hurt, max 7yr); one is a standalone IPC 420 (cheating, max 7yr) case; one is a corruption case under IPC 120B/307/452/436 with SC/ST POA Act. The rest (wrongful restraint, unlawful assembly, minor disobedience sections) top out under 5yr. Charges have been framed in 5 of the 12 cases (a mix of serious and non-serious); zero convictions in any.
